newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean Commercial Bank delays GDR issue.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean Commercial Bank delays GDR issue.

text.p: Commercial Bank of Korea has delayed its plan to issue $150 million worth of global depositary receipts in January, an official at the bank said on Thursday.
The official, who declined to be identified, blamed the local stock market's slump and foreign investors' lukewarm attitude toward South Korean issues for the delay.
Seoul's interbank foreign exchange traders had said the plan had been cancelled.

The bank official denied the issue had been cancelled and said: "The plan was not cancelled but was delayed... indefinitely. Whether we will try again for the issue will depend wholly on the future market trend."
